320.text: “It will be costly to get back on our feet, Mr. President. I don't know how to say this, but...”

321.speaker: Symon Holl
321.text: “Whatever we do, we need more budget. That's the bottom line. We need to squeeze out every single Sordish Ren we can to survive this.”

322.speaker: Symon Holl
322.text: “Like dominoes, of course, this will also affect the election.”

323.speaker: Player
323.text: “We need to stay at the top however we can.”

324.speaker: Player
324.text: “You are exaggerating. We will overcome this regardless. We survived so far.”

325.speaker: Player
325.text: “I will do whatever I can to bring us that budget. Even if that's the last thing I do.”

326.speaker: Symon Holl
326.text: “Otherwise... our country might be in a state to declare bankruptcy.”

327.speaker: Symon Holl
327.text: “Yes, and we need to fix this situation in order to do that.”

329.speaker: Symon Holl
329.text: “We haven't experienced a crash this bad since the last days of the Kingdom.”

330.speaker: Symon Holl
330.text: “We need to do our due diligence.”

338.speaker: Symon Holl
338.text: “The aid we have received from Arcasia has helped us tremendously.”
338.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptArcasia"] == true)

339.speaker: Symon Holl
339.text: “Personally I think it was a great decision, Mr. President.”

340.speaker: Symon Holl
340.text: “We will use the majority of the capital to combat the recession.”

341.speaker: Player
341.text: “I would expect nothing less from our Arcasian friends.”

342.speaker: Player
342.text: “Let's hope this decision won't come back to haunt us later on.”

343.speaker: Player
343.text: “I had to do whatever it took to end the recession. Even if it meant a deal with Arcasia.”

344.speaker: Symon Holl
344.text: “The aid we have received from United Contana has helped us a lot.”
344.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptArcasia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true)

346.speaker: Player
346.text: “I would expect nothing less from our United Contanan friends.”

347.speaker: Symon Holl
347.text: “Regardless of what they think, the capital will certainly be handy.”

348.speaker: Player
348.text: “I had to do whatever it took to end the recession. Even if it meant a deal with United Contana.”

349.speaker: Player
349.text: “Let's hope this decision won't come back to haunt us later on.”

350.speaker: Symon Holl
350.text: “There were many people who opposed this decision. Especially in the Lotherberg Group.”

351.speaker: Symon Holl
351.text: “We now have another weapon to combat the recession.”

352.speaker: Symon Holl
352.text: “I don't think that will be the case. Arcasians are known for their fair business.”

353.speaker: Symon Holl
353.text: “I don't think anyone in the room is questioning your decision, Mr. President.”

355.speaker: Symon Holl
355.text: “I sure do hope so as well.”

356.speaker: Symon Holl
356.text: “Sometimes we need to make sacrifices. I think everyone in this room understands that, Mr. President.”

473.speaker: Symon Holl
473.text: “Our debt situation is awfully bad, and I heavily advise against further expenditures. However, I will still present new projects and leave the decision to you, Mr. President.”

477.speaker: Symon Holl
477.text: “The good news is that the government has a perfectly balanced budget.”

481.speaker: Symon Holl
481.text: “We have the potential to take on additional debt to maintain the upward trend of the economy.”
481.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= 1) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -2) and ((Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] == 0) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] < 5) == false)

482.speaker: Symon Holl
482.text: “The important factor is that we don't take excessive debt going into the future.”

486.speaker: Symon Holl
486.text: “If we stabilize our crumbling infrastructure it would support some growth later. However, our industrial production also needs a boost to return to pre-recession levels.”

487.speaker: Symon Holl
487.text: “There are two main distinctions between these projects. It's either we improve our poor infrastructure or we invest in increasing production.”

488.speaker: Edith Agnoc
488.text: "Currency health and economic output degraded significantly and nearly crashed the Sordish Ren. Our currency is on the course to actually crash if we don't act."
488.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_Inflation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceSurge"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceFluctuation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 5) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_Inflation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceSurge"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceFluctuation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 3) == false)

489.speaker: Edith Agnoc
489.text: “Catastrophic losses in our financial strength are observed at the Central Bank. Especially compared to pre-election levels, inflation has increased by twenty percentage points year on year this quarter.”

491.speaker: Symon Holl
491.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_Inflation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceSurge"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceFluctuation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 3

492.speaker: Symon Holl
492.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_Inflation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceSurge"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Energy_PriceFluctuation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.BlackTuesdayHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.SuperpowerTradeWarHappened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 3) == false

512.speaker: Symon Holl
512.text: “We have enough of a budget to survive this crisis for some time. In order to navigate the financial repercussions of Black Tuesday, we must act in a fiscally liberal manner.”

517.speaker: Edith Agnoc
517.text: “Furthermore, the recent 'Black Tuesday' event caused dramatic economic upheavals in Sordland and the wider region.”

518.speaker: Edith Agnoc
518.text: “The Central Bank has begun working on a bill with the Grand National Assembly to increase our preparedness for future damaging economic incidents.”

519.speaker: Symon Holl
519.text: “I am looking forward to further collaboration between our departments to solve upcoming issues.”

520.speaker: Mikail Aven
520.text: “The NBC will also lend support to the analysis and contingency plans regarding the ongoing developments.”

524.speaker: Edith Agnoc
524.text: “The issues surrounding the energy prices and the imbalance they cause in the market are also of pressing concern. Average citizens and businesses are suffering.”

525.speaker: Edith Agnoc
525.text: “After the Central Bank Reinforcement Act, our focus will shift to primarily tackle the energy inflation crisis in the country. We will present a bill about this in the near future if the situation regresses.”

526.speaker: Edith Agnoc
526.text: “We are tackling these with measures we have in our power at the C.B. to stabilize the market.”

527.speaker: Symon Holl
527.text: “Our treasury is in a dangerous amount of debt.”

528.speaker: Symon Holl
528.text: “If we don't reduce our debt in the future we might fall in a debt crisis or worse.”

529.speaker: Player
529.text: “What are you suggestions on tackling this?”

531.speaker: Symon Holl
531.text: “I will work on some proposals regarding taxes to generate further revenues.”

535.speaker: Player
535.text: “Maybe we should be more cautious with the treasury.”

539.speaker: Edith Agnoc
539.text: “Furthermore, the recent 'Trade War' has caused dramatic economic upheavals in the wider region and Sordland.”

547.speaker: Symon Holl
547.text: “If we don't invest our resources when the country needs it, our future might be in a state of uncertainty.”

551.speaker: Deivid Wisci
551.text: “Rizia's Gasom co-investment has boosted our position in the region, but our failure to sign a significant trade deal with our neighbors has raised concerns.”
551.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_TradeDeal"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_Gasom_StateRiziaCoInvestment"] == true)

552.speaker: Deivid Wisci
552.text: “This has caused some imports and exports to drop."
